sample_unit: drug interaction pairs (43 Rx-OTC, 30 Rx-herbal supplement)

links.outcome: Accuracy and agreement of LLM drug interaction risk ratings versus Lexicomp reference
links.effect: All models underperformed, with accuracies below 50% and poor Cohen's kappa agreement with Lexicomp; GPT-4 and GPT-4o modestly better than GPT-3.5 at identifying higher-risk interactions.
links.quote: Our findings reveal that all models generally underperform, with accuracies below 50% and poor agreement with Lexicomp standards as measured by Cohen's kappa.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of off-the-shelf GPT models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o) on assessing drug-drug interaction risks against reference standard Lexicomp, without testing an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
